supersedes_note: The 2026-08-06 file is NOT modified and stays readable, so TASK-MX-001 results remain reproducible under the schedule they were computed with. This revision adds the broker component and the calendar-spread margining rule.
note: Exchange fees are transcribed from the venue's own contract params retained locally. The broker component is an OPERATOR ATTESTATION, not a document: no tariff page was ever obtained, because the broker returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches. The margining rule is published venue methodology; its numeric interest-rate-risk parameter was not obtained and is bounded rather than measured.

evidence_bases.REALISED: measured from executed round trips; unavailable, no MOEX order has ever been placed
evidence_bases.PUBLISHED_BROKER_TARIFF: the broker's own dated published rate for the account's tier; NOT ACHIEVED
evidence_bases.OPERATOR_ATTESTED: stated by the operator from direct knowledge of their own account, with no document filed; stronger than hearsay, weaker than a publication, and the account holder is the only party who can know the tier
evidence_bases.INFERRED_BOUND: derived from a published rule as a bound rather than a value

cost_algebra.note: FORTS charges a flat rouble fee per contract per side. Basis points are DERIVED, never primitive.
cost_algebra.exchange_fee_roundtrip_rub_EXPIRY_SETTLE: legs * buysellfee (entry) + (legs-1) * buysellfee + exercisefee (exit, near leg settles)

broker.tier_stated: retail, up to ~100 contracts per day
caveats: No tariff document was filed. zaoik.finam.ru and broker.finam.ru both return HTTP 403 to automated fetches; the pages are public in a browser.

A secondary source associated the 0.45 RUB rate with the Finam «Инвестор» plan, while the operator states «ЕДП / Трейдер». The plan attribution is unconfirmed. The rate itself is far below every breakeven in the frozen frontier, so the verdict is insensitive to which plan is correct.
The same secondary sources indicate the rate varies with both daily turnover and end-of-day net assets. A single figure therefore describes one tier, not the tariff.
Whether the broker charges its fee on a contract that settles at expiry rather than being traded out is UNKNOWN. The model charges it conservatively on all legs and sides.

margining.note: Calendar-spread margin is not a discount anyone selects. It is one of two published rules.

NETTO.applies_to_BR: through the second monthly expiration, i.e. the front/second pair
NETTO.numeric_parameter_status: NOT_OBTAINED - the NCC static-parameters page is client-rendered and yields no values to a plain fetch

POLUNETTO.blocked: the greater of the two legs' initial margin, not the sum

SUM.blocked: the sum of both legs' initial margin
SUM.applies_to_BR: never; this is the no-netting case and was what TASK-MX-001 conservatively charged

margining.computation_rule_justification: NETTO applies to the nearer, most-correlated expirations and blocks interest-rate risk instead of a leg's full margin. A netting regime reserved for the most-correlated pairs that produced a HIGHER margin than semi-netting would be incoherent. POLUNETTO is therefore used as an upper bound on the front/second funding cost. It is a bound, not a measurement, and must not be presented as the realised margin.

NONE.note: Fees only. Not a tradeable-realistic floor. A Stage 0 verdict may not be issued on this basis.

TICK_FLOOR.note: THEORETICAL LOWER BOUND. Assumes the bid-ask spread equals one minimum price step, crossed once in total per leg. Any report quoting it must label it a lower bound.

TICK_FLOOR_STRESS.note: Crosses the full one-tick spread on entry and again on exit, per leg. Still arithmetic from tick size, not a measurement of the book.

MEASURED.note: UNAVAILABLE. data/market/finam/orderbook/ contains zero files and no MOEX quote-tick source has ever been collected.

TRADE_OUT.note: Both legs closed by trading. The default.

EXPIRY_SETTLE.note: The near leg is allowed to settle at expiry, paying exercisefee instead of buysellfee. Cheaper in fees and materially different in risk: the leg fixes at the final settlement price, the position surrenders its choice of exit timing, and what remains is an outright far leg rather than a spread. Must be claimed explicitly.

undetermined: No measured bid-ask spread exists for any MOEX instrument in this project. data/market/finam/orderbook/ is empty. The TICK_FLOOR bases are arithmetic from minstep, not observations of a book. With the broker and margin components now closed, THIS IS THE BINDING UNKNOWN for the calendar contour.
No slippage measurement exists, because no order has ever been placed.
The numeric interest-rate risk under NETTO was not obtained; POLUNETTO is used as a bound and can only overstate the funding cost.
Whether the broker fee is charged on a leg that settles at expiry is unknown; it is charged conservatively.
The broker tariff has no filed document and its plan attribution is unconfirmed.
The scalper/non-scalper qualification rule as applied by the clearing house is not verified.
Evening-session and clearing-session fee treatment is not represented.
review_criterion: Replace, do not amend. Append a new entry on any of: a change of published venue params; a filed broker tariff document; the first measured bid-ask spread; the first reconciled executed round trip; the numeric NETTO interest-rate risk.
